newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Investec sees strong earnings, div growth.
newsitem.headline: Investec sees strong earnings, div growth.

text.p: South African banking group Investec Group Ltd said on Wednesday it expected to achieve strong growth in earnings and dividends in the future.
"The group's substantia capital base, breadth of skills and products, and emphasis on quality growth supports this opinion," the group said in a statement accompanying year end results.
Investec chairman Hugh Herman said that the group will retain its focus on international expansion within niche markets in order to further augment its existing offshore structure.
Investec earlier reported a 36.3 percent rise in headline diluted earnings per share to 572.1 cents ahead of analysts' expectations.
Analysts polled by Reuters forecast diluted earnings per share at between 550.0 and 558.3 cents with consensus at 552.8 cents.
The dividend at 260.0 cents was in the middle of analysts' range of estimates.
